summary: @Perednia You can do a pencast. Stack your phone on a pile of books to make a "doc camera" and then shoot the pages of the text as you read. Allows interrogation text and we know for younger students the benefits of finger tracking.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @Perednia You can do a pencast. Stack your phone on a pile of books to make a "doc camera" and then shoot the pages of the text as you read. Allows interrogation text and we know for younger students the benefits of finger tracking.
